RETRACTED.retracted_by: Wave S2c (audit remediation), executing Wave S2b's finding
RETRACTED.reason: This refit's ONLY fit target was cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998, and that benchmark's two comparator values are NOT measurements. Wave S2b established (~90% confidence, arithmetic exact) that MFT 342 ppb and FFT 200 ppb were derived INSIDE THIS REPOSITORY from data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3 -- an abstract-reconstructed range table committed in c7efbbc, the SAME commit that created the benchmark JSON. That table gives 'Ribose + Cys, pH 5 aqueous | 140 | 30 min' as MFT ~0.02-0.05 mol % and FFT ~0.01-0.03 mol %. On the benchmark's declared (and itself unattested) 10 mM basis with MW 114.17: 0.0300 mol % -> 342.5 -> 342 ppb, and the geometric mean of the FFT band, 0.017321 mol % -> 197.8 -> 200 ppb. Both shipped targets are interior points of two invented, OVERLAPPING bands. A barrier solved against the repo's own guess is circular, not calibrated.
RETRACTED.consequence: The one value this record moved -- thiol_addition_pentodiulose 28.60 -> 26.35 kcal/mol -- has been REVERTED to 28.60 in src/barrier_constants.py, which is the un-fitted `thiol_addition` CLASS value Wave N shipped. Measured cost on the retired benchmark itself, reported rather than buried: MFT 154.85 -> 78.09 ppb and FFT 267.50 -> 293.67 ppb against the fabricated 342 / 200, i.e. max_ratio 2.2086 -> 4.3797 and MALE 0.2352 -> 0.4041 dex. The row got much worse, which is what removing a fit to a non-measurement looks like. No other constant is affected: this record moved exactly one knob, and every other value it profiled was reported 'incumbent kept'.
RETRACTED.same_treatment_as: results/validation/hydrolysate_observability_rederivation.json, retracted by Wave I when its only two fit targets (spi_hvp_xylose_120C_PMC9905368, wheat_gluten_hvp_xylose_120C_PMC9905368) were found to be fabricated and its one applied value, the Methional base_factor, was reverted.
RETRACTED.what_this_does_NOT_retract: The fit-target ACCOUNTING is unchanged. cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998 remains a declared fit target of two OTHER live records -- results/validation/projection_constant_refit.json and results/validation/sulfur_barrier_refit_hofmann.json -- so it stays flagged `fitted_row: true` in results/validation/prediction_uncertainty.json and stays OUT of the honest-literature-coverage numerator and denominator. Retracting this record therefore does NOT let the benchmark back into the coverage claim, which is the correct outcome: values with no verifiable source must not be counted as literature evidence in either direction. scripts/ci/fit_target_gate.py skips retracted records (RETRACTION_KEYS), so the gate's requirement on this benchmark now comes from those two records instead of three. The gate is not weakened -- the flag it enforces is unchanged and still present.
RETRACTED.also_annotated: results/validation/sulfur_barrier_refit_hofmann.{json,md} is NOT retracted, because its fitted knob `thiol_addition_norfuraneol` (26.85) belongs to a family NO STEP EMITS since Wave N; reverting a barrier that reaches nothing would move no prediction while making the provenance record harder to read. It is annotated instead: its target was never literature either. See src/barrier_constants.py.
RETRACTED.do_not_use_as: a warrant for any shipped constant, or as evidence that the sulfur branch is calibrated in absolute terms. It is not. THE SULFUR BRANCH HAS ZERO ABSOLUTE LITERATURE ANCHORS.
RETRACTED.rebuild_condition: Do not re-run scripts/generators/refit_thiol_addition_pentodiulose_hofmann.py against this benchmark. It needs a real target first: the ILL retrieval in tasks/audit_remediation.md '## Wave S2b' section (f), then a rebuilt benchmark in native mol %.

fit_target_content_verification.note_verbatim: The paper's abstract reports MFT/FFT yields in mol % (e.g. MFT 1.4 mol % for its best precursor system), not ppb. The 342/200 ppb values here require a mol%->ppb conversion (system volume, precursor moles, molecular weights) that is NOT documented anywhere in this repo, and the full text is paywalled so the values could not be confirmed against the paper's tables. This is the panel's tightest contract (1.45x / 0.09 dex) resting on an unverified derivation. Needs: full-text access to 10.1021/jf9705983 and a written conversion, or replacement with the paper's native mol % as the target unit.
fit_target_content_verification.consequence_for_this_fit: This constant is fitted against an anchor whose mol%->ppb conversion is UNVERIFIED. If the conversion is wrong, the resulting error is LOCALISED in this one barrier rather than distributed across the route. That is the argument for doing the fit at all, and it is also the reason the value must never be quoted as a measured or literature-derived barrier.

objective: mean |log10(predicted_ppb / measured_ppb)| over the matched rows of cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998

decision_rules.conservative_edge: among values within indifference_dex of the profile minimum, adopt the LARGEST barrier (the least sulfur-favourable point the data cannot distinguish from the optimum)

thiol_addition_pentodiulose.range_basis: H2S/thiol addition to a carbonyl of a sugar-derived intermediate; low = thiohemiacetal_formation (23.30), high = thiol_addition_hexose (29.65), both already in FAST_BARRIERS. Same range the retired thiol_addition_norfuraneol knob used, so the two fits are directly comparable.
thiol_addition_pentodiulose.decision: IMMATERIAL — best achievable gain 0.0099 dex < 0.02 dex; incumbent kept

bounds_check.reading: The objective minimum sits AT a range endpoint. The data want a value the table's own sulfur-addition class envelope does not contain, i.e. the profile SATURATES: the residual is not removable by this barrier. The conservative-edge rule is what keeps the adopted value off the boundary.

co_movement.what_this_measures: The fitted knob sits on the MFT lane only. FFT shares the upstream sugar flux, so it can move without being fitted. Measured over the same grid.

fft_predicted_ppb.direction: FFT moves OPPOSITE to MFT: lowering the MFT barrier diverts shared upstream flux into the MFT lane and FFT falls. The two rows are therefore NOT independent evidence, which is exactly why one knob is fitted and not two.

comparison_to_retired_fit.why_comparable: Same benchmark, same objective, same decision rules, same defensible range, different ROUTE. Any agreement between the two adopted values is a coincidence of the shared upstream trunk, not evidence that the retired route was right.

fit_leverage.interpretation: ONE free barrier against 2 rows is 0.50 parameters per row, at src.fit_target_index.FIT_LEVERAGE_THRESHOLD (0.5). cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998 therefore stays OUT of the honest literature-coverage numerator and denominator and is reported in the fitted-row bucket. That classification is UNCHANGED by this refit -- the benchmark was already a declared fit target of the Wave H record. What changes is which constant carries the fit, and how much of the residual it can absorb.
fit_leverage.why_this_exclusion_does_not_flatter_the_: Excluding a fitted row removes its misses as well as its hits. Read `bounds_check` and `irreducible_residual`: even at the fitted value the model does not reproduce the measurement, and a fit that cannot reach its own target is a stronger negative result than any coverage number.
fit_leverage.what_would_fix_the_leverage: A second independent literature benchmark of the sulfur branch. After the Mottram1994 / Farmer1999 quarantine there is exactly one, and it is this one -- and its unit conversion is unverified.

furanone_cyclisation.reason_not_fitted: The competing branch of the same 1-deoxyosone fork (-> norfuraneol). Wave N set it EQUAL to `deoxyosone_reduction` (both 28.0) precisely to express no prior preference at that fork; fitting it here would encode a preference derived from two rows of one benchmark.

deoxyosone_reduction.reason_not_fitted: The upstream reduction that feeds the fitted step. It is in series with it, so on a single benchmark the two are not separately identifiable -- fitting both would split one measurable quantity across two constants and report the split as knowledge.

thiohemiacetal_formation.reason_not_fitted: FFT-side, not MFT-side. It moves the OTHER measured row of this benchmark, so fitting it would let the fit trade FFT accuracy for MFT accuracy across the two rows -- the classic two-row/two-knob recovery.

thiol_addition.reason_not_fitted: After Wave G1/Wave I this key labels only the DEMOTED hexose legacy shortcut and the lumped `Thiol_Addition_H2` FFT step. Fitting it would tune a lump the campaign exists to retire.

irreducible_residual.definition: objective with the fitted knob pinned at the BOTTOM of its defensible range — the best this one barrier can do on this benchmark
